1.title: 概覽
content: 俄羅斯女力士亞歷珊卓拉·札莉雅諾娃完美結合了單打獨鬥與團隊合作。簡稱為 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅，她能運用自身的力量扛起整個隊伍。玩家可以選擇配備自我防護與隊友防護的屏障，在團隊導向的玩法與「靠我一人就夠」的自我風格之間進行切換。

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的高傷害潛力讓她能夠彌補隊伍中輸出表現不佳的情況。另一方面，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以將每一道屏障都用在脆弱的隊友身上，藉此阻擋敵方攻勢並讓隊友創造出關鍵操作。身為一名 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅擁有中等水準的傷害減免能力，且根據能量累積的狀況，她可能會成為所有 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克中輸出最高或最低的角色。

1.1.1.title: 操作指南
content: * 僅在近距離主動攻擊敵人時對自己使用屏障，藉此建立並維持高能量。
* 護盾應採取反應式使用來保護隊友，而非預判式使用。優先選擇盟友明顯遭受攻擊的時刻，以最大化能量獲取與影響力。

* 配合隊友的後續絕招或爆發傷害來施放 ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧。只要能困住一到兩名敵人就足以贏得會戰。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 透過威脅性的爆發傷害或突襲，迫使她過早或無效地使用防護屏障，隨後暫時脫離戰鬥。

* 注意她的能量等級。高能量的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 威脅性極高，因此在戰鬥中要謹慎應對，並避免在她能量全滿時進行持久的單挑。
* 當她擁有「重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）」時，避免隊友聚集在一起。選擇讓她難以鎖定的位置，或保留防禦性技能來保護自己與隊友。

2.title: 優缺點總結
content: * 具備單人凱瑞潛力
* 中距離英雄
* 生存能力
* 需要高能量
* 無位移能力
* 護盾（Bubbles）使用不當會導致團戰失敗

3.1.1.title: 單人凱瑞潛力
content: 自私地使用防護屏障來累積高能量，並確保自己存活，直到你在 100% 能量時達到每秒 175 點傷害。滿能量的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以在 1.5 秒內融化任何 250 生命值的英雄！憑藉這種傷害潛力，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅總能找到獲勝的方法。此外，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障在遠距離拯救隊友，而無需放棄自己的位置或進攻節奏。

3.1.2.title: 中距離傷害
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅擅長在中距離（10 - 20 公尺）進行交戰。當面對近距離英雄（![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特、![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神等）時，她可以站在對方最佳射程之外，以自己的最大射程進行攻擊。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅不需要過度前壓，就能在射程內對躲在![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克身後的敵人施加壓力。次要攻擊也非常適合用來擊殺撤退中的敵人，其投射物速度在中距離表現相當穩定。

3.1.3.title: 生存能力
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的能量機制迫使敵方隊伍必須迅速做出決策：是要嘗試摧毀屏障，進而給予 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅更多能量，還是要等待 2 秒的持續時間結束，讓她能自由地推進或撤退。這些互動使得要擊殺 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅變得非常困難。此外，護盾生命值與自我治療被動技能的結合，讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅能夠短暫躲在掩體後方，並在沒有 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援角色的協助下快速恢復生命值。

3.2.1.title: 極度依賴維持高能量
content: 低能量的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅無法威脅任何人，也幾乎無法施加壓力。當敵方隊伍避免攻擊屏障，而你陷入低能量且沒有冷卻技能的狀態時，在兩個屏障冷卻完畢之前，你無法為隊伍提供任何實質貢獻。一名被低能量 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅攻擊的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士，可以安全地直接從她身邊走過並摧毀她的隊友。

3.2.2.title: 缺乏機動性且難以應對遠程英雄
content: 對於位於據點外圍或高處的敵人，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅處理起來非常吃力。她可以對攻擊這些敵人的隊友施放![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障（Projected Barrier），但也僅止於此。雖然次要攻擊跳躍可以提供些許額外的垂直位移，但距離太短，無法讓她登上大多數的高處區域。

3.2.3.title: 幾個糟糕的屏障就會輸掉會戰
content: 屏障的最佳使用方式相當複雜，關於對什麼目標、何時、何地以及對誰施放屏障的選擇，在整場比賽中會不斷變化。對一名你以為身陷險境但其實不然的隊友施放屏障，會讓其他隊友完全暴露在危險之中。將屏障用在抵擋一項敵方技能上，會讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅暴露在另一項敵方技能的威脅下。若連續浪費兩次屏障，通常意味著該場會戰已經輸掉，你的隊伍必須重新調整節奏。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：粒子砲
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/319945fa8ef79cf6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-cannon.png)粒子砲的技巧

* 當輸出型英雄與 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)醫護兵在射程範圍內時，優先以光束攻擊他們；只有在沒有更高價值的目標時，才將火力集中在敵方坦克身上。
* 在光束射程的最外緣進行交戰，以在維持壓力的同時將受到的傷害降至最低。

* 此光束無法被 ![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)反射，也無法被 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣或 ![](/data/assets/guide/7486123dd5edc842.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkinetic-grasp.png)動能補捉所吸收，這使其在面對這些英雄時相當可靠。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：能量榴彈（Energy Grenades）
content: **能量榴彈（Energy Grenades）使用技巧**
* 當目標超出光束射程時，使用次要攻擊來壓制聚集的敵人並累積絕招能量。
* 將次要攻擊穿插在彈藥循環中以最大化總體傷害輸出，特別是在彈匣即將耗盡時。

* 在近距離下，將次要攻擊與近戰攻擊結合是 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅傷害最高的爆發連段。
* 即使彈藥所剩無幾，你仍然可以發射一枚次要投射物。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：粒子屏障（自我防護罩）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/81b1062b5b25f966.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-barrier.png)粒子屏障的使用技巧
* 當你正在承受傷害或積極爭奪空間時，請以反應式的方式使用自我防護罩，而不是預判性地使用。
* 試著在明確進攻的時刻使用防護罩，例如當你成為敵方技能的目標，或是向前推進以施加壓力時。
* 避免在對峙階段過早使用自我防護罩，因為這會導致防護罩進入冷卻，使你在敵人重新發起進攻時變得脆弱。

4.4.title: [E]：投射屏障（隊友護盾）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障的使用技巧**
* 對承受巨大壓力或正準備採取激進攻勢的隊友施放護盾。

* 利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障來協助隊友進行突擊、側襲或前線推進，否則這些行動很容易遭到懲罰。
* 優先保護被敵方包夾的隊友，因為一個時機精準的護盾完全可以扭轉戰局。

4.4.1.title: 防護力場管理哲學
content: * 優先使用反應式防護力場而非預判式，因為針對已確認的傷害做出反應，比猜測敵方的時機更為穩定。
* 根據節奏決定是要在前期累積能量，還是採取嚴謹的冷卻時間循環——前期使用防護力場能累積能量但會拖慢戰鬥節奏，而保留防護力場則能在戰鬥中期提供更強的應對能力。
* 請注意，兩個防護力場共用冷卻時間，因此若對其中一個使用不當，將會限制你整體的防禦靈活性。

4.5.title: [Q] 重力噴湧
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧 的提示：
* 你不需要一次大招命中多個目標才能贏得會戰；確保擊殺一名高價值目標通常就足夠了。

* 在施放前，請先追蹤敵方的反制大招與減傷手段，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣、![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)冰牆、![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)超凡入聖 以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)音波屏障。
* 在進行長距離投擲重力噴湧前，先使用次要攻擊來測量拋物線與距離。
* 重力噴湧可以附著在任何表面上，將敵人懸浮在離地面稍高處，可以讓你的隊伍更容易進行後續輸出。

4.6.title: 能量（被動機制）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/385129e8606db3b6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy.png)能量的使用技巧
* 護盾所吸收的傷害會增加主要攻擊與次要攻擊的傷害。
* 若未持續減免傷害，能量將會衰退，因此請維持戰鬥節奏以保持高充能狀態。
* 高能量會大幅提升你的威脅等級，因此站位與屏障的使用時機應圍繞在維持有效充能，同時避免過度深入敵陣。

5.1.1.title: 偵查者（Spotter）
5.1.1.description: 投射屏障（Projected Barrier）會啟動盟友的生命值恢復效果，並提高其 20% 的移動速度。
content: * 對於輔助盟友而言極其強大。治療並給予速度加成能讓你的隊友成為隊伍的核心輸出。

5.1.2.title: 跳躍強化（Jump-Ups）
5.1.2.description: 次要攻擊的自我擊退效果增加 75%。
content: * 在擁有大量高地的地圖上表現最佳。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅通常在這些地圖上會感到吃力，但額外的跳躍高度為她提供了更多的機動性選擇。

5.2.1.title: 能量長槍
5.2.1.description: 粒子砲的光束可以穿透敵人。
content: * 最適合對付喜歡聚在一起打陣地戰的隊伍。鎖定後方的敵人，並調整角度，讓最前方的敵人也保持在光束的路徑上。

5.2.2.title: 額外衝擊
5.2.2.description: 當屏障啟動時，使用粒子砲的光束造成傷害可產生能量。
content: * 能停止能量衰減，且累積的總能量比單純承受傷害更多。當敵方隊伍很聰明，試圖避免幫你充能時，這項能力非常實用。

6.1.1.title: 南極半島
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅在控制地圖上通常表現良好，因為大多數這類地圖並不適合遠距離交戰。在南極半島上，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅缺乏機動性的弱點並不會妨礙她發揮價值。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅幾乎總能在這三個目標點的每一個點位中，強迫戰鬥發生在她的最佳射程範圍內。這張地圖上的高處區域也都在![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的有效射程之內，這使她成為一個絕佳的選擇。

6.1.2.title: 里亞爾托
content: * 雖然里亞爾托有幾個視野較長的區域，但也有大量的掩體供 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅運用。在進攻時，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以在掩體間移動時利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/81b1062b5b25f966.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-barrier.png)粒子屏障（Particle Barrier）進行推進。同樣地，在防守時，當受到壓力或屏障冷卻中，大多數區域都有附近的掩體可以躲避，待狀態恢復後再出來爭奪空間。

6.1.3.title: 灕江天塔
content: * 和南極半島類似，這張地圖的建築結構與 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的技能組非常契合。戰鬥焦點被迫集中在據點上，而這正是 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅最強勢的地方。![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）是清空控制據點的最佳絕招之一，因為多名敵人在爭奪據點時往往會聚集在同一個區域。

6.2.1.title: 好萊塢
content: * 好萊塢的每個據點都有太多長距離的視野和高地，導致 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅很難持續發揮作用。敵方的 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西是否正待在後方壓制你們全隊？好吧，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅基本上只能眼睜睜看著這一切發生，並試圖在與敵方前線的交鋒中取得優勢。

6.2.2.title: 新皇后街
content: * 為了讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅發揮成效，她基本上不能一直待在機器人旁邊。新皇后街是《鬥陣特攻2》中最開闊的地圖之一。在地圖的幾乎每個區域，敵方隊伍全體都能站在 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的攻擊範圍之外。如果她過度前壓去對付敵人，就會讓後排暴露在目標點上。戰鬥最終會演變成兩條戰線，並要求你的隊伍同時贏下兩場戰鬥。

6.2.3.title: 蘇拉瓦薩
content: * 閃擊點地圖蘇拉瓦薩的涵蓋範圍對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 來說太廣了。目標點分散得太開，導致敵方隊伍幾乎總能在 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 抵達前就佔據有利位置。此外，目標點過於暴露，使得 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 必須依賴自身的防護泡泡來維持生存，且在受到壓力時難以利用掩體。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅在鬥陣（brawl）陣容和機動（dive）陣容中都能有不錯的表現，但在面對消耗（poke）陣容或與其搭配時則較為吃力。

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人搭配
content:
![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏
* 除了![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)奈米強化（Nano Boost）之外，[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]投射屏障（Projected Barrier）是給予[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]源氏玩家最好的技能。[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]源氏需要深入敵陣後方大肆破壞。他很怕控場技能，任何控場技能命中[[__OWH_IMG_5__]]源氏通常就意味著他的死亡。[[__OWH_IMG_6__]]投射屏障能提供短暫的控場免疫，讓敵人很難處理[[__OWH_IMG_7__]]源氏。在[[__OWH_IMG_8__]]龍一文字（Dragonblade）期間給予屏障幾乎保證能至少擊殺一人。

* Aside from a ![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)Nano Boost, ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier is the best ability a ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji player can be given. ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji wants to be deep behind enemy lines and wreak havoc. He is weak to crowd control and landing any of the many CC abilities on ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji usually means his death. ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier grants temporary invulnerability to CC, making ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)Genji very hard for the enemy to deal with. A Bubble on a ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade almost guarantees at least one elimination.

![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)安娜
* ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)安娜的治療能讓[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]札莉雅進行極具侵略性的打法。生化手榴彈（Anti-Nade）的禁療效果也有助於擊殺那些[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]札莉雅在沒有禁療效果下難以擊敗的[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]坦克。對高能量的[[__OWH_IMG_5__]]札莉雅施放[[__OWH_IMG_6__]]奈米強化（Nano Boost）簡直能摧毀敵方隊伍。大多數英雄即便看到發光的[[__OWH_IMG_7__]]札莉雅衝過來，也無法及時逃脫。此外，[[__OWH_IMG_8__]]札莉雅可以透過時機精準的[[__OWH_IMG_9__]]投射屏障，從敵方[[__OWH_IMG_10__]]側襲者（Flanker）手中救下[[__OWH_IMG_11__]]安娜（這是[[__OWH_IMG_12__]]安娜的弱點）。

* The classic “Grav Dragon” remains one of the best ultimate combos to this day. The only real counter to Grav Dragon is ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta's ![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)Transcendence, but that counter can be countered. If ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya lands two or more people in ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)Graviton Surge, the combo all but declares victory.
![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana

* ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana's healing enables mega aggressive play for ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya. Anti-Nade also helps to get elims the ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks that ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya struggles to beat without the anti-healing effect. ![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)Nano Boost on a high energy ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya just demolishes the enemy team. Most heroes can’t run away fast enough even if they see the glowing ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya coming at them. Moreover, ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya can save her ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana from enemy flankers (who ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana is weak to), with a well-timed ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)Projected Barrier.

8.title: 如何反制
content: 無論擔任什麼副角色，反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的主要方式就是避免讓她獲得能量，並找出她使用防護罩的規律。如果她總是過早使用防護罩，那就先等待效果結束再發動攻勢。如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅在你看向她隊友時會驚慌地給予防護罩，那就轉而攻擊 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅本人，因為她已經沒有防護罩可以保護自己了。有時進行短暫的撤退並重新調整位置，可以讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/385129e8606db3b6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy.png)能量（Energy）開始衰退，這能讓你的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克在重新爭奪目標時承受較少的傷害。

8.1.title: 特定英雄剋制關係
content:
![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔
* 無論![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)札莉雅的能量（Charge）有多高，只要有[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]支援（Supports）在為他治療，她在拉瑪塔格擋時就無法擊殺他。[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]札莉雅也很難從拉瑪塔身上獲取能量，因為他可以輕易地在防護力場（bubbles）期間使用護盾或格擋。憑藉[[__OWH_IMG_5__]]復仇型態（Nemesis Form）的速度加成以及渦流（Vortex）的緩速效果，拉瑪塔可以輕易地在[[__OWH_IMG_6__]]札莉雅試圖在防護力場冷卻間隙撤退到掩體後方時進行追擊。

* No matter how high ![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)Charge ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya is, she’s not killing Ram while he’s blocking if his ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports are healing him. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya also struggles to get charge from Ram because he can easily shield or block during bubbles. Between ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form's speed boost and Vortex’s slowing effect, Ram can easily chase Down ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya when she attempts to recover behind cover between bubbles.

![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)小美
* ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)小美對[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]札莉雅的剋制取決於誰的技術更勝一籌。如果[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]冰牆（Ice Wall）將[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]札莉雅與她的隊伍隔開，這幾乎保證能完成擊殺，或者至少能用你的一個冷卻技能換掉對方的兩個防護力場，以及[[__OWH_IMG_5__]]札莉雅的[[__OWH_IMG_6__]]支援（Supports）大量技能。[[__OWH_IMG_7__]]冰霜衝擊槍（Endothermic Blaster）的緩速效果對於沒有自我防護力場可用的[[__OWH_IMG_8__]]札莉雅來說是極強的懲罰。對[[__OWH_IMG_9__]]小美而言的危險在於，如果她的[[__OWH_IMG_10__]]冰牆（Ice Wall）施放失誤，[[__OWH_IMG_11__]]札莉雅的近距離傷害將遠超[[__OWH_IMG_12__]]小美的近距離主要攻擊。

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)巴帝斯特
* 面對![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅足以贏得團戰的絕招，只需在轉角處放置一個![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)不滅力場（Immortality Field）就能保住全隊的性命。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)巴帝斯特的遠程消耗傷害也高到足以逼出防護力場。當你對試圖進攻敵方![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)巴帝斯特的隊友施放防護力場時，他擁有太多生存工具，很可能不會被擊敗，而你則會損失一個防護力場。
![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei

* ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei countering ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya depends on who can outplay the other. If an ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall cuts off ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya from her team, it's pretty much a guaranteed elim, or will trade your one cool down for both bubbles, and a ton of ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya's ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports' abilities. The Slow effect of ![](/data/assets/guide/6f0829d84c10e9e2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fendothermic-blaster.png)Endothermic Blaster is a really strong punish against a ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya caught without a self bubble available. The danger for ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei is that if she messes up her ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall, ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya's close-range damage far exceeds ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei's close-range primary fire.
![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste

* Against ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya's big fight winning ultimate, simply placing an ![](/data/assets/guide/3adb743da6c064fe.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fimmortality-field.png)Immortality Field around a corner can keep his entire team alive. ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste's poke damage is also high enough to force out bubbles. When bubbling an ally trying to engage an enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)Baptiste, he has so many survivability tools he likely won’t be defeated and you’ll be out a bubble.
